newsitem.title: SWEDEN: H&M shares fall on fears of overpriced.
newsitem.headline: H&M shares fall on fears of overpriced.

text.p: Shares in Swedish fashion retailer Hennes & Mauritz dropped five percent in early Friday trading on the Stockholm bourse amid media and broker reports indicating the share was overpriced.
By 1010 GMT, the share had tumbled 55 crowns to 1,040 crowns, while the general index was flat.
Dealers said some media reported that the share was by far the most expensive on the Stockholm bourse, after rising strongly earlier this week amid rumours of a share split and ahead of Q4 earnings.
"The share could very well keep falling another 50 crowns or so," a trader said. "But on the other hand, this share's movements are very hard to predict."
